description: This file defines a custom exception class OrleansConfigurationException used within the Orleans runtime project. It includes constructors for message and inner exception, and is serializable.

classes.name: OrleansConfigurationException
classes.description: A sealed class representing configuration-related exceptions in Orleans runtime, derived from Exception, marked as serializable.

methods.name: OrleansConfigurationException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor accepting an error message and an inner exception for chaining.

methods.name: OrleansConfigurationException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
